definitions.explanation: A fee paid to whoever introduces a customer, client, or candidate — common in real estate, recruiting, marriage agencies, and various brokered services.

examples.japanese: {紹介料|しょうかいりょう}を{払|はら}う。
{紹介料|しょうかいりょう}は{無料|むりょう}です。
{採用|さいよう}が{決|き}まった{場合|ばあい}にのみ{紹介料|しょうかいりょう}が{発生|はっせい}する。
examples.english: A referral fee is charged only when a hire is confirmed.

notes:
Compound of {紹介|しょうかい} (introduction) + {料|りょう} (fee). Standard term in industries where customers or candidates are brokered.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {紹介料|しょうかいりょう}を{払|はら}う: to pay a referral fee
- {紹介料|しょうかいりょう}が{発生|はっせい}する: a referral fee is charged
- {紹介料|しょうかいりょう}{無料|むりょう}: no referral fee
- {成功|せいこう}{報酬|ほうしゅう}{型|がた}{紹介料|しょうかいりょう}: success-based referral fee

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {仲介料|ちゅうかいりょう}: brokerage fee — for transactions like real estate or business deals
- {手数料|てすうりょう}: service charge; commission — broader term for any handling fee
- {成功報酬|せいこうほうしゅう}: success fee — paid only when a deal closes
